**Finding submitted: MISSING (insurance clause absent).**

- **Investigation:** Full read of the single-section document plus targeted searches ("insurance", "coverage / certificate / workers compensation / errors and omissions / cyber", and a regex for "maintain … polic/insur") returned no responsive language. No exhibits are attached to the body, so the rule's clause is genuinely absent.
- **Why it matters:** Kubient is a hosting/ad-serving vendor that expressly undertakes the "collection, maintenance, management and storage of visitor information (data)" (¶9(b)(iii)) and places creatives on our Properties — no insurance for a vendor processing our data is walk-away territory under the playbook.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` operation adding new clause 14(j) at the end of General Provisions, carrying exactly the six preferred elements: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber and privacy USD 5M keyed to any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer (Customer Data is undefined here, so the trigger is drafted comprehensively rather than by named examples), statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request. No at-own-expense language, survival tail, or other non-element boilerplate was added; the fallback limits are offered in the comment.
